text:
lena: Proposal: add a 'spillover leash' to config rollouts. When a cohort is throttled, stop automatic routing spillover to sibling cohorts to avoid cascading pressure.

josh: So instead of sending extra traffic to cohort B when A is throttled, we hold/spread it out?
lena: Exactly. Either hold at the edge for short windows, or route to a fallback model/capacity tier. Main goal: avoid hammering neighbors.
ravi: We need clear semantics: hold queue limits at edge? drop? prefer hold with backpressure headers so callers can retry.
maya: UX: Console should show "spillover paused" with a timeline and which cohorts are affected. Also an easy "allow temporary spillover" flow that requires owner approval + audit note.
devon: Metrics to add: `config.spillover_attempts`, `config.spillover_blocked`, `config.spillover_allowed_temp`. Alert when spillover_blocked > 10 in 1m for prod cohorts.
cara: SRE: default policy should be conservative. If infra-impacting flag, do not allow spillover by default. If traffic-smoothing flag, allow but with strict leash. Need safemode: oncall can enable global spillover with TTL and audit.
josh: Implementation plan: edge/router keeps a small token-bucket per target cohort representing how much spillover it's willing to accept. When source cohort is throttled, router consults buckets and either forward, hold, or 429 with `X-Config-Spillover: blocked`. This keeps checks local and cheap.
lena: Example leash config (dry-run):

```yaml
flag: use_new_ranking
spillover_leash:
  mode: hold  # hold | drop | fallback
  hold_queue_size: 100
  accept_rate_per_minute: 600
  owners: [lena, devon]
  override_policy: team+2fa
```

configbot: preflight: schema OK. WARNING: leash-enabled flags must bind `config.spillover_blocked` telemetry. Suggest auto-insert.
ravi: we should auto-provision a minimal dashboard and alert stub when leash is enabled. Fail preflight otherwise.
maya: Console copy when leash fires: plain English one-liner + "why" + suggested next steps (open dry-run, request temporary spill). Make default messaging non-technical for PMs.
devon: I'll propose alert thresholds and a default dashboard layout. Start: alert if spillover_blocked > 20 in 5m OR spillover_attempts/spillover_allowed_temp > 5%.
cara: Runbook: 1) check timeline and spillover trace ids; 2) evaluate fallback capacity; 3) approve temporary spillover with TTL if safe; 4) if infra flag, open incident and notify infra oncall.
josh: perf: per-request check should be very fast; token-bucket per-cohort at edge is O(1). Need microbench at 50k rps.
lena: security: overrides require owner + 2FA + a mandatory justification string saved in audit logs. Auto-revoke after TTL. Weekly override report to security/product.
ravi: edge-case: what if hold queue grows and clients give up? We'll surface `Retry-After` and track client-side retries as part of telemetry. Consider a graceful fallback option to a cheaper model.
maya: Add a "simulate" mode in Console where you can see what would have spilled over without actually changing routing. Good for rehearsals.
lena: Action items: lena -> RFC draft + sample config; josh -> perf harness; devon -> alert thresholds & dashboard; cara -> safemode + runbook; maya -> console mocks & copy; ravi -> auto-provision dashboard + preflight rule.
configbot: reminder: create RFC under /eng/flags/rfcs and link preflight id 1785559999.
lena: thanks folks :rocket:
